title: bomify plugin progress event
description: One line of the file a component pull's --progress flag names, per plugins/contracts/component/v1/CONTRACT.md: how much of one part of the component, such as a file or a layer, has been pulled.

name.description: The part, which bomify shows as a bar of its own: a file's path, or a layer's short digest.

current.description: Bytes of the part pulled so far, in all; not since the last line.

total.description: The part's size in bytes. Absent or 0 when unknown.
